loss_l1.definition: mean absolute RGB error from the branch selected by the native exposure gate
loss_l1.availability: Recorded by gaussian-loss-v1 rows; historical rows remain unavailable

loss_ssim.definition: 1-SSIM of canonical rendered RGB and target
loss_ssim.availability: Recorded by gaussian-loss-v1 rows; historical rows remain unavailable

loss_regularization.definition: mean visible minimum activated Gaussian scale

loss_normal.definition: full H*W mean of masked-zero edge_weight * L1(native alpha-weighted depth normal - accumulated plane normal)

loss_geometry.definition: accepted-pixel mean detached exp(-roundtrip_error) * roundtrip_error in pixels

loss_multiview.definition: accepted-patch mean of detached roundtrip weight * native squared-correlation LNCC loss; not a sum of geometry losses

loss_depth.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED AS A SEPARATE TERM

exposure: PGSR appearance parameters change the gated L1 branch; gaussian-loss-v1 records both L1 branches and the selected branch, but exposure is not a separate additive loss
missing_policy: Empty CSV cell/null means unavailable; never substitute zero. Logged scheduled-inactive zeros are retained as observations.
comparison_warning: Total objectives differ across models; lower total loss is not evidence of better reconstruction
